اكتسحا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَسَحَا (iktasaḥā) /ik.ta.sa.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اُكْتُسِحَا (uktusiḥā) /uk.tu.si.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اِكْتَسِحَا (iktasiḥā) /ik.ta.si.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
